verses.text: For the choirmaster. According to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. Help, O LORD, for the godly are no more; the faithful have vanished from among men.

segments.text: For the choirmaster. According to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. Help, O LORD, for the godly are no more; the faithful have vanished from among men.

verses.text: They lie to one another; they speak with flattering lips and a double heart.

segments.text: They lie to one another; they speak with flattering lips and a double heart.

verses.text: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips and every boastful tongue.

segments.text: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips and every boastful tongue.

verses.text: They say, “With our tongues we will prevail. We own our lips—who can be our master?”

segments.text: They say, “With our tongues we will prevail. We own our lips—who can be our master?”

verses.text: “For the cause of the oppressed and for the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD. “I will bring safety to him who yearns.”

segments.text: “For the cause of the oppressed and for the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD. “I will bring safety to him who yearns.”

verses.text: The words of the LORD are flawless, like silver refined in a furnace, like gold purified sevenfold.

segments.text: The words of the LORD are flawless, like silver refined in a furnace, like gold purified sevenfold.

verses.text: You, O LORD, will keep us; You will forever guard us from this generation.

segments.text: You, O LORD, will keep us; You will forever guard us from this generation.

verses.text: The wicked wander freely, and vileness is exalted among men.

segments.text: The wicked wander freely, and vileness is exalted among men.
